title: Irreversible Coupling-Architecture Modification in Dual-Substrate Systems: Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking, Vacuum Stabilization, and the Structural Necessity of a Finite Localization Window

canonical_node.axiom: A dual-substrate system with a fundamental high-symmetry substrate and a derivative broken-symmetry substrate can undergo irreversible coupling-architecture modification via spontaneous symmetry breaking and vacuum stabilization, without altering the internal physics of either substrate.
definitions: Coupling architecture: the set of interaction channels, coupling constants, selection rules, and conservation laws between two subsystems.
Locking threshold (_lock): the minimum duration a broken-symmetry state must persist to become irreversible.
Fundamental substrate (_F): high-symmetry, temporally unbounded substrate.
Derivative substrate (_D): broken-symmetry, temporally bounded substrate.
Coupling-domain observable: a measurable quantity that is a function of the coupling architecture C rather than of _D internal physics.
derivation: Spontaneous symmetry breaking in _F can occur via localization into _D.
If the localized state persists for duration t  _lock, the symmetry break becomes irreversible (Property 1).
The broken-symmetry vacuum remembers the break (Property 2) and permits new physics (Property 3).
Coupling-architecture modification is distinct from substrate modification and is invisible to probes confined to one substrate.

The theological sequence (Incarnation, Crucifixion, Resurrection, Pentecost) maps operation-by-operation to the physical sequence: SSB with VEV acquisition, latent energy release, vacuum confirmation, phase-front propagation.
The model generates four falsifiable predictions and identifies open proof obligations.
canonical_node.action: Treat the model as a candidate structural correspondence, not a proven isomorphism. Test its falsifiable predictions and pursue the open proof obligations (categorical construction, _lock derivation, coupling-domain observables).
boundary: Does not claim physics proves the Resurrection occurred.
Does not claim _F is God; only structural correspondence.
Does not explain why the symmetry-breaking event occurred.
Does not claim the dual-substrate framework is established physics; it is speculative extension.
test: Prediction 1: Coherence signatures in collective human systems during the locking period.
Prediction 2: A specific peak location in coherence measurements.
Prediction 3: _lock (33 years) should be derivable from first principles.
Prediction 4: The modification is invisible to electromagnetic observation.

dg1_dependencies: Standard spontaneous symmetry breaking formalism (Goldstone, Higgs, Nambu).
Gdel's Incompleteness Theorems and Tarski's Undefinability Theorem (as constraints).
Category theory (Eilenberg & Mac Lane) for isomorphism claims.
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a structural model that maps a specific theological sequence to known physical mechanisms, generating falsifiable predictions and identifying open proof obligations.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the standard physics of SSB and vacuum stabilization; does not alter internal physics of either substrate.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If the dual-substrate framework or the mapping is removed, the model reduces to a theological narrative with no physical content.
dg5_translation_registers: Physics: SSB, vacuum stabilization, coupling architecture, energy conservation.

classification.recommended_atom_action: Quarantine as speculative research draft; require explicit categorical proof and _lock derivation before further integration.

overstatement_risks: Claims of 'no new physics' may overstate the speculative nature of the dual-substrate framework.
Theological identification may be seen as imposed rather than emergent.
The 33-year _lock is a free parameter, not derived.
The model's predictions are vague and not yet operationalized.
kill_conditions: If _lock cannot be derived from first principles.
If the categorical construction fails to preserve operations.
If coupling-domain observables cannot be formally defined or measured.
If the model is shown to be unfalsifiable.
risk.lean_target: Reduce to a minimal structural correspondence hypothesis with explicit open problems; avoid any claim of proof.

plain_summary: This document proposes a speculative model where the Incarnation, Crucifixion, Resurrection, and Pentecost correspond to spontaneous symmetry breaking, vacuum stabilization, energy release, and phase transition in a dual-substrate system. It explicitly states that the correspondence is not proven and lists open problems. The model is internally coherent but not established; it should be treated as a research draft with significant open proof obligations.
